svg.title: The final project, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Module 2 final project. A taped circle has one short strip of tape across its line on the right-hand side: the cross, about half as long as the robot is wide. The robot starts at the bottom of the circle and follows it to the cross. Its sensors reach the cross first and it stops; it drives forward to park its wheels on the cross, then turns clockwise in place; the cross is too short for the sensors to touch, so the turn carries on until they find the circle behind, facing the other way. It follows the circle all the way round the other way and meets the cross again from the other side, and reverses there the same way. Four reversals, and it stops. A panel beside it names each stage: following to the cross, cross detected and reversing, and done.
svg.text: 1. Follow the circle to the cross
2. Park on it and turn around
The cross is one short strip: long
enough for both sensors to see it,
too short to stop the turn. So one
clockwise turn carries on to the
circle behind, and the robot meets
